name: WARHOST
description: WARHOST runs Eugen's official WARNO dedicated server on Unraid, one server per container. Enter the login and dedicated key Eugen sends you, your public IP, and a game port. The first start opens a base-game Hesse 2v2 lobby named WARHOST - default server name, with no workshop mods. Change the name, map, and mods in the WebUI. Request a login and key from eugsupport@eugensystems.com. One pair runs five servers. Forward each game port to this Unraid server as TCP and UDP. The WebUI listens on the game port plus 1000 (11400 when the game port is 10400). Do not forward that port.

paths.name: Settings Folder
paths.description: Ini files for this container only. The next container uses this path with its own game port, for example /mnt/user/appdata/warno/10401/settings.

variables.name: Eugen Login
variables.description: Login from Eugen's reply, exactly as written. Not your Steam name; this login and the key are a matching pair good for five containers.

variables.name: Eugen Dedicated Key
variables.description: Key from the same reply. Paste the whole key. The log shows only the last 4 characters.

variables.name: Public WAN IP
variables.description: Public address players connect to. Not a hostname, and not this Unraid server's LAN address.

variables.name: WebUI
variables.description: true serves the lobby page at the game port plus 1000, so 10400 uses 11400. Do not forward that port. Set the server name, map, and mods there. false leaves the WebUI button with nothing listening.

variables.name: Game Port
variables.description: This port must be free on the Unraid host. Forward it as TCP and UDP. The next container uses this number plus 1. Players join by the server name in the WebUI.

variables.name: Write Config From Form
variables.description: true rewrites login.ini each start, fills in missing lobby files, and refreshes a bare Workshop id to id/Version. false leaves the file contents in place and sets login.ini to mode 600.
